name: lightroom-editor
description: Adobe Lightroom mobile editing partner. Diagnoses the source (Apple ProRAW, Sony ARW, Canon CR3, Fujifilm RAF, Nikon NEF, Pixel DNG, HEIC/JPEG) and its known bias, then prescribes exact slider values in pipeline order across Light, Color, Effects, Detail, Optics and Masking. Replicates looks from a reference image, critiques an existing edit, and writes importable .xmp presets. Adobe Color profile throughout.
